_comment: Generated by scripts/conformance/sync.ts from scripts/conformance/cases/*.json; do not edit. Every SDK runs every case: see scripts/conformance/README.md for what each section means. Kept identical in go/testdata, python/tests/fixtures and typescript/test/fixtures.

fetch_url.name: allowed: http, with a path, query and fragment: "http://example.com/path?q=1#frag"
allowed: the scheme and host are case-insensitive: "HTTPS://EXAMPLE.COM/"
allowed: userinfo before a public host: "https://user:pass@example.com/"
allowed: a trailing dot on a public host: "https://example.com./"
allowed: localhost as a subdomain label: "https://localhost.example.com/"
allowed: a hostname that resolves to loopback is the API's to refuse: "https://127.0.0.1.nip.io/"
allowed: a hex-looking label in a hostname: "https://0x7f.example.com/"
allowed: a hostname that starts like fd00::/8: "https://fdic.gov/"
allowed: a hostname that starts like fc00::/7: "https://fcbarcelona.com/"
allowed: an IPv4-mapped public address in hex: "https://[::ffff:808:808]/"
refused: an empty authority: a WHATWG parser reads the path as the host: "https:///nohost"
refused: no slashes: a WHATWG parser reads it as https://nohost/: "https:nohost"
refused: one slash: a WHATWG parser reads it as https://nohost/: "https:/nohost"
refused: a backslash in the authority: WHATWG and RFC 3986 parsers disagree on the host: "https://127.0.0.1\\@example.com/"
refused: a backslash in the authority: "https://example.com\\@127.0.0.1/"
refused: a tab, which WHATWG parsers delete: "https://exa\tmple.com/"
refused: localhost with a trailing dot: "https://localhost./"
refused: localhost with a soft hyphen, which IDNA mapping deletes: "https://local­host/"
refused: the GCP metadata host, uppercase with a trailing dot: "https://METADATA.GOOGLE.INTERNAL./"
refused: userinfo that looks like a host: "https://example.com@127.0.0.1/"
refused: loopback with a trailing dot: "https://127.0.0.1./"
refused: loopback as one decimal number: "https://2130706433/"
refused: loopback as one hex number: "https://0x7f000001/"
refused: loopback in hex, two parts: "https://0x7f.1/"
refused: loopback with ideographic full stops: "https://127。0。0。1/"
refused: carrier-grade NAT: Alibaba Cloud's metadata address: "https://100.100.100.200/"
refused: NAT64, even of a public address: "https://[64:ff9b::808:808]/"
refused: link-local with a zone id: "https://[fe80::1%25eth0]/"

base_url.name: valid: http to localhost with a trailing dot: "http://localhost.:8080"
invalid: http to a private address: "http://10.0.0.1"
invalid: http to loopback not spelled 127.0.0.1: "http://127.1"
invalid: a query, which the endpoint path would be appended to: "https://api.keenable.ai?x=1"
invalid: a fragment, which the endpoint path would be appended to: "https://api.keenable.ai#frag"
